summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ premium accumulation in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in 2026 and 2027. While NVDA shows extreme intraday call dominance (P/C 0.17 with $430.2M in BuyCalls), the SPX/SPXW flow shows significant hedging via large-scale 7770P and 7800P accumulations for late 2026. The most critical signal is the persistent, multi-day buildup of SPX 7000C (exp 2026-09-18) totaling over $3.7B, suggesting a massive institutional bet on a sustained bull market through 2026. Traders should watch for volatility expansion in the semiconductor space (NVDA, MU, AMD) and monitor if SPX maintains support levels near the 7000-7770 corridor, as the heavy long-dated call buying implies a high-conviction floor is being established.
